result.title: PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification
result.comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code will be released at https://github.com/miralab-ai/PhaseCLIP upon publication
result.summary: Remote-sensing (RS) image scene classification aims to assign a semantic category to an overhead image, and in practice must often do so from only a handful of labelled examples, since annotation requires expert interpretation and the resulting labels transfer poorly across sensors and regions. Recent progress has come from adapting vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP, through learned prompts or feature adapters. Although effective, these methods construct their representation entirely in the spatial domain. RS scenes are dominated by periodic texture and regular geometry, which the Fourier spectrum describes compactly through an amplitude component, carrying texture and contrast statistics, and a phase component, carrying spatial structure. Existing frequency-domain adaptation of VLMs either exploits amplitude alone or does not separate amplitude from phase, leaving the structural component unused. In this article, we propose PhaseCLIP, which inserts phase-capable spectral modules and a feature-gating module into a frozen CLIP visual encoder and trains only 1.30% of its parameters. Because the amplitude and phase pathways share an identical parameter layout, a single weight set is learned on phase and transferred exactly to amplitude, giving a two-stage scheme that adds no parameters. Experiments on five public RS datasets, EuroSAT, PatternNet, UC Merced, LSRS and RSSCN7, against eight baselines under a matched protocol, show that PhaseCLIP attains 84.28% mean accuracy and is the best method in 23 of 30 dataset-by-shot cells, with phase contributing 1.93 points overall and 4.36 points on the most difficult dataset. Because the modules act on the spectrum of image patches and transformer tokens and leave the text encoder untouched, the approach can be extended to other RS sensors and tasks, and to other domains in which class evidence lies in spatial structure.

AI.brief_summary: 针对少样本遥感场景分类，在冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器中插入相位感知的频域谱模块与特征门控模块，仅训练约 1.3% 参数，并通过相位与幅度共享同一套权重的两阶段方案提升分类精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身是面向分类的 CLIP 参数高效适配，不涉及 latent 推理状态；但其中把相位承载的空间结构信息单独成路并加门控注入冻结编码器的做法，可能为 LVR 中「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态」及视觉通路门控提供可核查的机制线索。
